answer: Joining takes a 70-credit bond and one pair of receipts: a canyon work receipt and an inlet payment receipt. Both share key, amount and epoch; an auditor pairs them on the public karst ledger. A rented work receipt fails, since its payment twin bears a different key. A lone receipt forfeits the bond. Pair k pays 45+5(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 with 70,000 locked, versus a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its share.
